stem.text: A uniform square sign of weight $40\,\text{N}$ is suspended vertically from its top edge by a horizontal hinge, as shown.

stem.alt: Front view of a square sign hanging from a horizontal hinge bar along its top edge; labelled hinge, sign, 0.80 m vertically and 0.80 m horizontally.
Side view of a thin vertical sign attached at its top to a hinge; labelled hinge and sign.

stem.text: The hinge is not frictionless. When the sign is displaced from the vertical by an external force and then released, it does not return to the vertical position.
The maximum torque exerted by the hinge on the sign is $6.0\,\text{N m}$. The sign is displaced by $90^{\circ}$ so that it is horizontal and then gradually released.
At which angle to the vertical does the sign hang after release?
